text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working freelancer with 6 years of experience building practical AI and automation solutions.

I’d be glad to help set up your Tawk.to chat bot system and add the automation triggers you need across multiple websites. I have extensive experience with Python, machine learning, and NLP tools, and I’m comfortable working on ongoing chatbot improvements as your portfolio grows.

One relevant project I built was a Delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics, where I created a WhatsApp and SMS assistant that tracks parcels, reschedules deliveries, and hands off to a human with full context. That system resolved 43% of conversations without an agent and achieved a CSAT of 4.4 out of 5.

I’d be happy to help you build a reliable setup and support future website additions as well.
